Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Principal Machine Learning Engineer


What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will Own enterprise AI/ML architecture, standards, APIs, and guardrails across cloud/on-prem.


We are seeking a Principal Machine Learning Engineer—Amgen’s most senior individual-contributor authority on building and scaling end-to-end machine-learning and generative-AI solutions. Sitting at the intersection of engineering excellence and data-science enablement, you will develop, deploy and monitor models—classical ML, deep learning and LLMs—securely and cost-effectively. Acting as a “player-coach,” you will establish AI solution strategy, define technical standards, and partner with DevOps, Security, Compliance and Product teams to deliver a frictionless, enterprise-grade AI solutions.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Own enterprise AI/ML architecture, standards, APIs, and guardrails across cloud/on-prem.
  • Build production ML/GenAI solutions and lightweight apps delivering sub-second insights.
  • Build end-to-end ML pipelines—data ingestion, feature engineering, training, hyper-parameter optimisation, evaluation, registration and automated promotion—using Kubeflow, SageMaker Pipelines, Open AI SDK or equivalent MLOps stacks.
  • Build and maintain full-stack AI applications by integrating model services with lightweight UI components, workflow engines or business-logic layers so insights reach users with sub-second latency.
  • Establish observability, SLOs, and safe deploys (blue-green/canary, shadow, rollbacks) with incident runbooks.
  • Lead rigorous evaluation (offline/online, A/B), drift detection, and automated retraining.
  • Architect LLM/RAG with prompt management, safety guardrails, and optimized inference.
  • Enforce data quality, lineage, and model/data cards; apply privacy-preserving techniques where needed.
  • Contribute reusable ML/GenAI components—feature stores, model registries, experiment-tracking libraries—and evangelize best practices that raise engineering velocity across squads.
  • Perform exploratory data analysis and feature ideation on complex, high-dimensional datasets to inform algorithm selection and ensure model robustness.
  • Prototype and benchmark new algorithms, offering guidance on scalability trade-offs and production-readiness while co-owning model-performance KPIs.
  • Translate domain needs (R&D, Manufacturing, Commercial) into roadmaps; mentor teams and communicate trade-offs.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a Principal Machine Learning Engineer with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:


Doctorate degree and 2 years of Machine Learning Engineer experience

OR

Master’s degree and 6 years of Machine Learning Engineer experience
OR
Bachelor’s degree and 8 years of Machine Learning Engineer experience
OR
Associate’s degree and 10 years of Machine Learning Engineer experience
OR
High school diploma / GED and 12 years of Machine Learning Engineer experience

In addition to meeting at least one of the above requirements, you must have a minimum of 2 years experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs, or directing the allocation or resources. Your managerial experience may run concurrently with the required technical experience referenced above

  • 3-5 years in AI/ML and enterprise software.
  • Strong command of machine-learning algorithms—regression, tree-based ensembles, clustering, dimensionality reduction, time-series models, deep-learning architectures (CNNs, RNNs, transformers) and modern LLM/RAG techniques—with the judgment to choose, tune and operationalize the right method for a given business problem.
  • Proven track record selecting and integrating AI SaaS/PaaS offerings and building custom ML services at scale.
  • Expert knowledge of GenAI tooling: vector databases, RAG pipelines, prompt-engineering DSLs and agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel).
  • Proficiency in Python and Java; containerization (Docker/K8s); cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP) and modern DevOps/MLOps (GitHub Actions, Bedrock/SageMaker Pipelines).
  • Strong business-case skills—able to model TCO vs. NPV and present trade-offs to executives.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management; can translate complex technical concepts into concise, outcome-oriented narratives.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in Biotechnology or pharma industry is a big plus
  • Published thought-leadership or conference talks on enterprise GenAI adoption.
  • Master’s degree in Computer Science and or Data Science
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) for project delivery.

Education and Professional Certifications

  • Master’s degree with 10-12 + years of experience in Computer Science, IT or related field

OR

  • Bachelor’s degree with 12-14 + years of experience in Computer Science, IT or related field
  • Certifications on GenAI/ML platforms (AWS AI, Azure AI Engineer, Google Cloud ML, etc.) are a plus.

Soft Skills:

  • Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work effectively with global, virtual teams
  • High degree of initiative and self-motivation.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities successfully.
  • Team-oriented, with a focus on achieving team goals.
  • Ability to learn quickly, be organized and detail oriented.
  • Strong presentation and public speaking skills.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

Position Summary

AmeriVet is seeking a strategic and highly collaborative Manager, Talent Acquisition Programs to design, lead, and scale national programs that strengthen our early career engine and elevate the AmeriVet brand and employee value proposition. This role will focus on College of Veterinary Medicine engagement, technician training programs, and a national conference strategy that drives top-of-funnel awareness, candidate engagement, and conversion. Serving as a strategist and program leader within the Talent Acquisition function, this person will partner closely with Medicine, Marketing, DVM Engagement leaders, and Talent Acquisition stakeholders to build integrated programs that support early career hiring goals and strengthen AmeriVet’s position as an employer of choice. This role has no direct reports.

Talent Acquisition Program Strategy

  • Lead the strategy, planning, and execution of Talent Acquisition programs that support AmeriVet’s early career hiring goals and broader workforce priorities.
  • Serve as a strategic partner to Talent Acquisition leadership, translating organizational goals into scalable programs that drive pipeline growth, engagement, and conversion.
  • Develop program roadmaps, success measures, timelines, and stakeholder alignment plans to ensure consistent execution and measurable outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve candidate journeys across early career, conference, and engagement channels, with a focus on moving prospects from awareness to hire.
  • Use data and stakeholder insights to assess program effectiveness, recommend improvements, and prioritize initiatives that create the greatest impact.

Key Responsibilities

Early Career Engine

  • Build and manage AmeriVet’s early career talent engine, with a focus on College of Veterinary Medicine engagement, technician training programs, externship pathways, and entry-level hiring pipelines.
  • Partner closely with Medicine to design programs that support early career hires, strengthen clinical readiness, and create meaningful engagement before and after hire.
  • Collaborate with DVM Engagement leaders to align early career initiatives with broader doctor engagement, student outreach, and retention strategies.
  • Create scalable programming that connects prospective veterinarians and technicians with AmeriVet hospitals, mentors, learning opportunities, and career pathways.
  • Track top-of-funnel activity, engagement, application flow, offer acceptance, and conversion outcomes to continuously refine early career strategies.

National Conference Strategy & Employer Brand

  • Develop and lead a national conference engagement strategy that elevates the AmeriVet brand, strengthens awareness of the employee value proposition, and increases candidate engagement.
  • Partner with Marketing to define conference messaging, booth experience, collateral needs, lead capture processes, follow-up campaigns, and brand activation opportunities.
  • Create a consistent operating model for conference planning, execution, post-event nurture, and conversion tracking.
  • Collaborate with field, Medicine, Marketing, Talent Acquisition, and DVM Engagement stakeholders to ensure conference investments are aligned to hiring priorities and brand goals.
  • Measure conference impact through lead volume, engagement quality, source conversion, candidate progression, and hiring outcomes.

Stakeholder Partnership & Program Leadership

  • Act as the connective tissue across Talent Acquisition, Medicine, Marketing, DVM Engagement, field leadership, and other partners to ensure programs are coordinated, aligned, and executed with excellence.
  • Facilitate regular stakeholder planning meetings to align on priorities, program performance, upcoming initiatives, and actions needed to support hiring goals.
  • Bring a strategic point of view on how AmeriVet can increase awareness, deepen engagement, and convert high-potential early career candidates into hires.
  • Create tools, playbooks, and repeatable processes that allow Talent Acquisition and business partners to execute programs consistently across markets.

Data, Funnel Management & Conversion

  • Own program reporting and analytics for early career and conference channels, including lead capture, source performance, candidate progression, conversion rates, and hiring outcomes.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition leadership to define KPIs, establish baselines, monitor progress, and identify opportunities to increase top-of-funnel volume and improve conversion.
  • Analyze trends across schools, training programs, conferences, markets, and candidate segments to inform investment decisions and program prioritization.
  • Prepare insights and recommendations for leadership that connect program activity to hiring goals, brand awareness, candidate engagement, and return on investment.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of campus recruiting, early career programs, university relations, employer branding, or related program management experience.
  • Experience building or scaling early career, internship, externship, student engagement, technician training, or workforce pipeline programs.
  • Strong strategic planning, project management, and cross-functional stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with clinical, business, marketing, and talent acquisition leaders to design and execute high-impact programs.
  • Experience developing employer brand or candidate engagement strategies that support awareness, attraction, and conversion.
  • Expertise using data, reporting, and funnel metrics to evaluate program performance and inform decisions.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Veterinary, healthcare, higher education, or national conference strategy experience preferred.

Travel - up to 30-40%

About N-Power Medicine

N-Power Medicine aims to establish a new paradigm in drug development by reinventing the ‘how’ and transforming clinical trials through better integration with clinical practice, ensuring broader participation by physicians and patients. We are building an exceptional multi-disciplinary team with diverse expertise spanning healthcare, engineering, technology and regulatory, and with people who share our core value of Empowering Community through generosity, curiosity and humility. We are working with urgency to bring better therapies to patients faster.

Position Overview

The Sr. Director, Clinical Research Operations is responsible for building and leading the full operating model for how N-Power executes clinical research at our network practices — from the onsite Clinical Research Staff (CRS) who manage prescreening, consenting, and protocol-driven assessment coordination in partnership with treating physicians, to the regulatory and clinical trial operations work ensure programs are run in a compliant manner following applicable rules and regulations.

This is a newly created, senior leadership role accountable for the staffing model, capacity planning, resource allocation, training infrastructure, engagement strategy, and performance metrics across the full function, spanning both the distributed CRS field team and the Clinical Operations team responsible for regulatory execution.

This is a remote role.

Role Objectives and Responsibilities

Staffing Model, Capacity Planning & Performance Management

  • Build a repeatable and scalable staffing model tied to health system profile, clinical programs, enrollment targets, and patient volume across all sites

  • Define productivity and success metrics for the CRS team (e.g., prescreening throughput, consent conversion) tied to business and pharma customer delivery targets

  • Build dashboards and reporting cadences that give leadership visibility into team and site performance

  • Use performance data to identify skill gaps and direct training investment where it matters most

Leadership & Execution

  • Build the playbooks, SOPs, and management cadence needed to run a consistent, high-quality distributed field team

  • Directly manage the Clinical Operations team, ensuring regulatory work such as study-startup, TMF management, documentation, site/IRB coordination, and site monitoring is a tightly integrated part of the same function

  • Build scalable training and development infrastructure for a distributed field and regulatory operations workforce

  • Train onsite team to represent N-Power’s mission and value proposition to practices

  • Serve as an escalation point for site-level relationship risks and support rollout of new initiatives or workflow changes across the network

  • Partner closely with Network Operations leadership and other cross-functional teams to align CRS and Clinical Operations priorities with broader network strategy

Perform additional duties and responsibilities as required.

Education, Experience, Behavioral Competencies, & Skills

  • 9+ years of experience in clinical research operations, with direct, hands-on oncology clinical trial experience

  • Proven success managing a distributed, multi-site workforce at scale

  • Strong experience in oncology research and practice workflows, including academic/community research workflows, practice business administration.

  • Demonstrated ability to build repeatable playbooks, SOPs, and processes as teams and programs grow

  • Metrics-driven: experience building staffing models, capacity plans, and KPI/reporting frameworks from scratch

  • Experience designing training and development infrastructure for a distributed clinical workforce

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders, clinical teams, and technical experts alike

  • Collaborative, hands-on leader who thrives in dynamic environments; generous, curious, and humble

Preferred

  • Familiarity with CTMS, EDC, or similar clinical trial systems as they relate to site-level workflow

Travel Requirements

Travel expected as needed to support regional teams. Up to 25%

Pay Information

The expected salary range for this position is $215K-270K. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. N-Power Medicine (NPM) offers equity at hire as well as a discretionary annual bonus which may be available based on Company performance. This position is eligible for company benefits.

More About Us

We are a mission-driven, well-funded, rapidly growing company, eager to attract passionate professionals offering a highly attractive compensation package with a balanced and flexible work environment, competitive industry benefits as well as a 401K plan.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the U.S. on a full-time basis. The Company will not sponsor applicants for work visas.

Please note that state-specific background checks and screenings may be required for this role. Employment is contingent upon successfully passing all applicable screenings.

Staff Product Manager, Transactions & Trust

Company

Collaborative Boating operates Boatsetter and GetMyBoat, the two largest marketplaces for getting on the water, now converging into one platform. Guests arrive wanting something specific, like a fishing trip, a sunset cruise, or a birthday on a pontoon. We connect them to the captains, operators, and owners who can make it happen. Finding and booking a day outside should be as easy and intuitive as booking a flight.

The problem

Every booking is a promise between strangers. A guest pays in advance for a day that depends on weather, a captain, and a boat. An operator hands over something worth more than a house to someone they've never met. Between "Book Now" and the operator getting paid, a lot has to go right. The price has to be clear, fees have to be explained, insurance has to be in place, credits and changes have to be handled, and disputes have to be resolved fairly.

Our mission is simple to say and hard to do. Every dollar on the platform should move accurately, on time, and transparently enough that everyone involved trusts us more after each transaction than before it. Today that path runs across two legacy brands and is being rebuilt as one platform. There’s a wealth of historical data, context and learnings to draw from. What's left are the decisions: how insurance should work across regions, what a guest should see before paying, and how fees should be structured so they're fair to both sides and sustainable for the business. These decisions are waiting on someone to own them.

What you'll own

  • The full money path, and the strategy behind it. You'll own every step from "Book Now" through financial settlement: checkout, payments, payouts, fees, insurance, credits, and dispute resolution, across both brands, web and mobile. You'll turn a proposed sequence of what's left to build into a strategy the company commits to, and revise it when the evidence says you should.
  • Insurance, as a product and a program. You'll decide where we stand on insurance by region, how coverage is verified, how it's priced into an order, and how it works outside the US. These are decisions with legal, financial, and partner consequences. You'll frame them, get them made, and deliver on them.
  • Fees that people understand. You'll build a fee structure the business can adjust, and a breakdown that shows guests and operators exactly where every dollar goes, before they pay and after they're paid.
  • Credits, changes, and disputes. You'll own what happens when a trip changes, a guest is owed something, or the two sides disagree about what was promised.
  • Reviews on one platform. You'll lead the move to a single review system across both brands, so reputation earned on one carries over to the other.
  • Core business outcomes. Examples include checkout conversion, payment success, payout accuracy and timing, dispute rates, and the share of transactions that stay on-platform. Many of them depend on teams you don't run.
  • The hard tradeoffs. Guest protection against operator fairness, transparency against conversion, flexible policy against predictable revenue.
  • Influence beyond the pod. The money path only works if finance, operations, support, insurance partners, and the rest of product work with it. You'll shape their roadmaps through clear reasoning and shared goals, not escalation.
  • A stronger PM practice. You'll mentor other PMs, help shape how we hire, and improve the way product work gets done here.

How we work

Problem, then system, then experience

We frame the problem first. Then we settle the shape of the system, meaning the entities, states, and constraints. Only then do we design the experience inside it. In this domain, the system is the product: what an order is, what it's made of, which states it can move through, and what money moves when it does. We map the domain in event-storming sessions, write behavior as concrete scenarios before building it, and record decisions in RFCs and architecture decision records. You'll help write them, not wait for them. If you're used to handing over a PRD and returning at launch, this will be frustrating.

Discovery is ongoing, not a handed off spec

You talk to guests and operators directly, every week, alongside your designer. You'll read the support queue, sit in on dispute reviews, and learn what a payout problem actually costs an operator. Discovery doesn't end in a slide deck. It ends in a decision, and when work stalls waiting for one, getting that decision made is your job.

We ask what moved, not what shipped

You define the signal before release and watch it after. Hitting the number you set is the minimum, not the goal. The work worth remembering beats it. In this domain, the results often show up late and in someone else's metrics. A clearer fee breakdown might show up in fewer support contacts, and a verification change might show up in claims months later. You need to know where to look. Sometimes the answer is that the bet didn't work. When that happens, you say so plainly, and we kill it.

We ship in days, not quarters

Work goes live the day it's ready. There's no launch calendar and no approval chain. The pod decides and it goes out. Moving money raises the standard for being ready, but it doesn't slow the cadence. That means guarded rollouts, reversible changes, and reconciliation you can trust, then the next slice. Your strategy sets the order of work, not a release schedule. It tells the pod which narrow, finished slice matters most this week, and why the next one follows.

We cross lines, and we bet on each other

Titles and team boundaries carry little weight here. You'll be in a finance close review, on a call with an insurance partner, talking to an operator whose payout went sideways, and helping discovery decide how fees and coverage should appear in search. Ask for help early and give it generously. The standing assumption is that the person next to you is good and worth backing before they've proven it, and we'll make the same assumption about you.

What you need to have done

  • Owned strategy for checkout, payments, or payouts in a two-sided marketplace with company-level impact. You authored the strategy, not just executed it.
  • Hit ambitious OKRs that crossed team lines. Walk us through one you set: how you knew it was ambitious, what you traded to get there, and what you did when it slipped.
  • Unblocked a decision with real stakes. Pick one where legal, finance, partners, or leadership had to agree before the work could move. Tell us how you framed it, who disagreed, and what happened next.
  • Made pricing or fees transparent without losing revenue. Tell us what you showed, what you held back, why, and what happened to conversion and trust afterward.
  • Designed policy as product. You've treated cancellation, refund, credit, or dispute rules as something to build, test, and improve, not as legal text someone else wrote.
  • Made the PMs around you better, through mentorship, hiring, or fixing how the team works.

What also helps

Insurance products, embedded insurance, or coverage verification, especially across regions or countries. Hands-on experience with payment processors, marketplace payouts, or split payments. Building configurable fee or pricing systems. Chargeback and dispute operations. Migrating live transactions between platforms without breaking bookings in flight. Review and reputation systems. Travel, rentals, or local-services marketplaces at scale. Comfort pulling your own data. Each of these is a plus, not a requirement.

Practicals

Remote, with high overlap with US Eastern hours. You'll report to our Chief Product Officer, join a fully resourced product team with a dedicated designer, and be the dedicated PM in this pod. Relevant degrees are welcome and not required. A track record of shipped, measured work outweighs credentials.

About the Company

MAP International is seeking a strategic, mission-driven Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to join its Executive Leadership Team during an exciting season of organizational growth, innovation, and global ministry impact. For more than 70 years, MAP International has lived out its mission of providing medicines and health supplies to people in need around the world so they may experience life to the fullest. Today, MAP facilitates the distribution of more than $1.3 billion annually in donated medicines and health supplies, bringing hope and healing to millions of people worldwide.

About the Role

Reporting directly to the President & CEO, the CFO will provide executive leadership for MAP’s financial strategy, stewardship, accounting operations, treasury, financial planning, compliance, and enterprise risk management. This leader will also serve as a trusted strategic advisor to the President & CEO, Board of Directors, and Executive Leadership Team. This is not a turnaround opportunity. MAP enjoys exceptional financial health, mature financial controls, a highly capable finance team, and a culture deeply committed to stewardship and accountability. The next CFO will inherit an outstanding foundation and help position one of the world’s leading Christian global health organizations for its next chapter of growth and impact.

Responsibilities

  • Provide executive leadership for financial operations, accounting, treasury, budgeting, forecasting, cash management, financial reporting, and long-range financial planning.
  • Ensure compliance with GAAP, nonprofit accounting standards, gift-in-kind accounting requirements, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Oversee annual audits, tax filings, internal controls, and enterprise risk management.
  • Partner closely with the President & CEO and Executive Leadership Team on organizational strategy, financial modeling, and long-range planning.
  • Deliver timely, accurate, and meaningful financial reporting and strategic guidance to executive leadership and the Board of Directors.
  • Lead, coach, and develop an exceptional finance team while strengthening systems, processes, and professional development.
  • Collaborate across the organization to support sound decision-making, faithful stewardship, and long-term financial sustainability.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field required.
  • 10+ years of progressive financial leadership experience.
  • Previous experience serving as a Chief Financial Officer or senior finance executive.
  • Significant nonprofit financial leadership experience required.
  • Expertise in nonprofit financial management and reporting.
  • Experience with complex nonprofit accounting, including restricted funding and gift-in-kind accounting, preferred.
  • Experience partnering with Boards of Directors and executive leadership teams.
  • CPA strongly preferred; MBA and experience with ECFA standards or an ECFA-accredited organization are highly desirable.
  • International ministry, healthcare, pharmaceutical, or global nonprofit experience is preferred.
  • Strong expertise in strategic financial planning, forecasting, treasury, audit oversight, regulatory compliance, enterprise risk management, and financial systems.

Executive Leadership Competencies

The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

  • A mature and growing relationship with Jesus Christ consistent with MAP's mission and Statement of Faith.
  • Executive presence coupled with humility.
  • High emotional intelligence and relational maturity.
  • Exceptional communication and collaboration skills.
  • Strategic thinking balanced with operational awareness.
  • Strong judgment and discernment.
  • A collaborative leadership style that values partnership over hierarchy.
  • The ability to influence through relationships rather than authority.
  • A growth mindset balanced with faithful stewardship.
  • Calm, thoughtful leadership during organizational complexity and change.
  • A genuine passion for using financial stewardship to advance Kingdom impact.

Required Skills

The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in strategic financial planning, forecasting, treasury, audit oversight, regulatory compliance, enterprise risk management, and financial systems.

Preferred Skills

Beyond technical expertise, MAP is seeking an executive leader who demonstrates humility, emotional intelligence, sound judgment, collaboration, and strategic thinking. The successful candidate will have a mature and growing relationship with Jesus Christ consistent with MAP’s mission and Statement of Faith and a genuine passion for using financial stewardship to advance Kingdom impact. This leader will value partnership over hierarchy, influence through trusted relationships, and balance a growth mindset with faithful stewardship.

Pay range and compensation package

MAP International is headquartered in Brunswick, Georgia. The position may be performed remotely or through relocation to the Brunswick area. Periodic travel for Board meetings, leadership retreats, and select ministry events will be expected. Anticipated salary range: $150,000–$180,000, based on experience, qualifications, and whether the successful candidate serves in a remote or relocated capacity. MAP also offers a competitive executive benefits package designed to support employees and their families.

Equal Opportunity Statement

For the right leader, this is far more than an opportunity to steward financial resources. It is an opportunity to help shape the future of a financially healthy, growing Christian ministry whose work delivers medicines, health supplies, hope, and healing to millions of people around the world. If you are an accomplished nonprofit financial executive who desires to combine executive leadership, financial excellence, faithful stewardship, and eternal purpose, we invite you to consider this opportunity.

For more detailed information: MAP International CFO Opportunity Profile

Position Description

PingWind is seeking a Data Scientist II who will provide technical, analytical, and lifecycle support to the Maritime Electronic Warfare Systems Division (MEWSD) for critical U.S. Navy Electromagnetic Warfare (EW), Decoy, and Surface Electronic Warfare Improvement Program (SEWIP) systems. This role supports cradle-to-grave activities, including engineering, technology transition, installation, logistics, product support, test and evaluation, sustainment, maintenance, and repair. The Data Scientist II will integrate logistics, data science, reliability and maintainability engineering, and operations research to analyze and model complex systems, improve operational availability, and support data-driven decisions. This position directly contributes to optimizing warfighting capability, system readiness, reliability, and lifecycle performance while balancing mission requirements, performance, and cost.

Responsibilities

Typical Responsibilities/Tasks:

  • Develop and implement analytical techniques and applications that transform raw data into meaningful, actionable information supporting operational and program decision-making.

    • Develop and maintain repeatable analytical processes, models, and reporting solutions that improve data quality, consistency, traceability, and accessibility.
    • Collaborate with logisticians, engineers, operations research analysts, and program personnel to translate mission and business requirements into analytical solutions.
    • Prepare and present technical reports, analyses, visualizations, and briefings that enable timely, informed decision-making and continuous performance improvement.

Required Qualifications

About Nucleus Global

Nucleus Global is a global leader in the medical communications space with locations across Europe, US, and APAC and a portfolio of 90-plus clients. It forms part of the Inizio Medical group, which includes Ashfield MedComms, ApotheCom, and MEDiSTRAVA. Its unique position as part of this international network, which includes three of the world’s top medical communications companies, gives it a key advantage over its commercial competitors in terms of the scale of its reach and depth of its expertise.

About the Role

As a Client Services Director/Associate Vice President, you'll provide strategic leadership for a key global client account spanning Medical Affairs and Publications. You'll serve as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, overseeing the successful delivery of integrated scientific communications programs while ensuring exceptional client service, operational excellence, and commercial performance.

Working closely with Scientific Services and cross-functional teams, you'll shape account strategy, identify opportunities for growth, mentor high-performing Client Services teams, and help strengthen a long-term client partnership built on collaboration and innovation.

Here's What You'll Be Doing

  • Lead the strategic direction and day-to-day oversight of a key client account delivering integrated Medical Affairs and Publications programs.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, acting as a strategic advisor and confidently navigating complex business conversations.
  • Partner with Scientific Services, Editorial, Digital, Creative, and Operations teams to develop and deliver high-quality scientific communications aligned with client objectives.
  • Oversee account financial performance, including forecasting, budgeting, profitability, resource planning, and identifying opportunities for organic growth.
  • Lead, coach, and develop Client Services team members, fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture.
  • Drive operational excellence by implementing best practices, improving delivery processes, and ensuring consistent, high-quality execution across the account.
  • Support business development through proposals, strategic planning, and identifying opportunities to expand the client partnership.
  • Collaborate with senior leadership to support broader business initiatives, resource planning, and the continued evolution of our client services offering.
  • Stay informed on industry trends, including Medical Affairs, scientific publications, AI, and omnichannel engagement, bringing innovative thinking and strategic insights to clients and internal teams.

About You

  • Extensive Client Services experience within a medical communications agency, with significant experience supporting Medical Affairs and/or Publications accounts.
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships with senior pharmaceutical clients and lead complex, integrated scientific communications programs.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience managing budgets, forecasting, profitability, and driving organic account growth.
  • Experience leading, coaching, and developing high-performing Client Services teams while collaborating across multidisciplinary functions.
  • Excellent strategic thinking, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to influence, solve problems, and lead through complexity.
  • Experience supporting business development activities, including proposals, pitches, and growing existing client partnerships.
  • A collaborative, solutions-focused leader who is passionate about delivering exceptional client experiences, developing people, and driving continuous improvement.

In addition to a great benefits package, we are happy to talk flexible working. We are also known for our friendly and informal working environment with socials across our offices, regular wellbeing drop in sessions, and Town Hall events. We offer excellent opportunities for career and personal development, including opportunities to transfer your skills to our other offices around the world.

Im Bereich des Frontend und der App unterstützt du bei der

Qualifikation

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in TypeScript und React oder React Native (Hooks, Komponentenstruktur, API-Integration, State-Handling)
  • Du arbeitest selbständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert

Benefits

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! 😊

      <title>Samsara: Staff Software Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://www.samsara.com/">https://www.samsara.com/</a>
</p>

<p><strong>About the role:</strong></p>
<p>Samsara (NYSE: IOT) sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world. The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We're still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we're hiring the engineers who will build what comes next.</p>
<p>We're approaching ~$2B ARR growing 30%+ year over year, with 96% of our largest customers on two or more products. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale.</p>
<p>We're looking for software engineers who want to define what ships next. Leveling is broad and flexible: we're hiring from Senior through Staff+, across platform and product, and we're open to shaping scope around the right person's strengths and interests. That window won't stay open long.</p>
<p><strong>This role is remote and open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.</strong></p>
<p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>You want to impact the industries that run our world.</strong>&nbsp;The software you build will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. What ships here isn't metrics on a dashboard. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor.</li>
<li><strong>You want to build, not maintain.</strong>&nbsp;Samsara is in full growth mode. We're building new systems from scratch, not babysitting old ones. You'd own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one.</li>
<li><strong>You want to work where AI meets the physical world.</strong>&nbsp;Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models.</li>
<li><strong>You believe customers are more than a number.</strong>&nbsp;Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with product managers and customer success, and use that context to build products that solve real problems operators face every day.</li>
<li><strong>You have the curiosity and drive to figure it out.</strong>&nbsp;We're looking for people who take pride in their work and get things done at all costs. The engineers who thrive here don't wait to be told what to build. They define it, ship it, and own the outcome. The rate-limiting step on our teams isn't tooling or process. It's ambition.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong>&nbsp;</p>
<ul>
<li>Take ownership of technically complex, mission-critical areas and run with them. We want to point you in a direction and show up to the demo meeting impressed, not spend our weeks managing the details.</li>
<li>Define and drive technical strategy for new products and platform capabilities, from backend services and APIs to the customer-facing UI.</li>
<li>Design and ship full-stack features end to end. You'll work across backend, frontend, and potentially mobile to deliver AI-powered products that solve real operational problems.</li>
<li>Partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous, real-world problems into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes.</li>
<li>Build and scale the systems behind AI-driven products, including data ingestion, APIs, and the workflows that put intelligence into the hands of operators.</li>
<li>Raise the bar for the engineers around you through code reviews, design reviews, technical mentorship, and by setting a standard for quality, velocity, and craft.</li>
<li>Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Minimum requirements for the role:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.</li>
<li>8+ years of experience in software design and development, including building and operating production systems at scale.</li>
<li>Strong full-stack fundamentals. You're comfortable working across backend services, APIs, and frontend (web or mobile) to ship complete products.</li>
<li>Proficiency in modern languages and frameworks (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, or similar).</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience leading cross-team or cross-org projects from inception through rollout, including managing ambiguity, driving alignment, and delivering measurable impact.</li>
<li>Experience building AI-powered or data-driven products. You don't need to train models, but you know how to take AI capabilities and turn them into products customers love.</li>
<li>Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.</li>
<li>A track record of building: zero-to-one products, systems you left in a meaningfully better place, or hard problems you refused to let stay unsolved.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>An ideal candidate also has:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience shipping AI-powered features in production, whether that's LLM-based products, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, or other customer-facing AI.</li>
<li>Comfort with modern AI-augmented development workflows (Cursor, LLMs, etc.) to multiply your output and accelerate delivery.</li>
<li>Background working with real-world operational data (telematics, sensor data, work orders, inspections) or a strong interest in learning the domain.</li>
<li>A proven track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering culture, standards, and best practices beyond a single team.</li>
<li>Side projects, open-source contributions, or other signals of curiosity and drive outside the scope of your day job.</li>
</ul>
<div class="content-pay-transparency">
<div class="pay-input">
<div class="description">
<p>The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.</p>
</div>
<div class="title">Annual Base Salary</div>
<div class="pay-range">$162,400<span class="divider">—</span>$290,000 USD</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="content-conclusion">
<p><strong>Total Rewards</strong></p>
<p>At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why&nbsp;<a href="https://www.samsara.com/company/careers/benefits">our rewards</a>&nbsp;are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.</p>
<p>Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.</p>
<p><strong>Flexible Working&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.</p>
<p><strong>Belonging at Samsara</strong></p>
<p>At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.</p>
</div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/samsara-staff-software-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/samsara-staff-software-engineer</a></p>
</description>

      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6373/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Beloit, WI 
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://acculynx.com">http://acculynx.com</a>
</p>

<h2><strong>Senior Software Engineer</strong></h2>
<p>AccuLynx is a fast-growing SaaS provider of business management software for roofing contractors. With more than 10 years in the business and impressive year-over-year revenue growth, we have quickly established ourselves as the leading software product in this multi-billion dollar industry.</p>
<p>AccuLynx is actively looking for smart and passionate Senior Software Engineers to join our growing Engineering team! We are headquartered out of Beloit, WI and would love to have you join us for major planning sessions and meetings, but this role has the option to be remote. We do not hire based on buzzwords or popular acronyms. We expect you to have mastered at least one language and be eager to master any technology or language in the future. If you want to be part of a collaborative team committed to providing a best-in-class software user experience, please read on!</p>
<p>What You Will Do:</p>
<ul>
<li>Support Engineering team in delivering well-written, well-tested code to complete new features or address issues in the product</li>
<li>Collaborate on the design, implementation, testing and review of new features and fixes</li>
<li>Review code and contribute feedback to improve the quality, readability, and testability of the code base across Engineering</li>
<li>Architect, design, develop, deploy and operate services that serve AccuLynx’s thousands of users</li>
<li>Use Agile process to experiment and improve on software development practices at AccuLynx</li>
</ul>
<p>What might you work on?</p>
<ul>
<li>Implement real time communication tools to connect our customers.</li>
<li>Create a fast and responsive work-scheduling application for use in the field.</li>
<li>Build an automation platform so our customers can customize their workflow to reduce wasted movement.</li>
<li>Solve advanced mapping and geolocation problems.</li>
<li>Build out our public RESTful API.</li>
<li>Review junior Engineering team members’ work for accuracy and provide coaching and feedback</li>
<li>Perform other related duties as assigned</li>
</ul>
<p>Your Qualifications:</p>
<ul>
<li>Top notch coding skills</li>
<li>7-10 years of software development experience</li>
<li>7+ years of full-stack web development: frontend, backend and database</li>
<li>Smart and gets things done</li>
<li>Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills</li>
<li>Belief that performance is a feature</li>
<li>Experience with our stack: Vue.js, C#, Sql Server, Redis, ElasticSearch, Git</li>
<li>Confidence you will make a difference in our product</li>
<li>Leverages AI-powered development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to accelerate coding, testing, and debugging workflows while maintaining high code quality standards</li>
<li>Actively evaluates and integrates emerging AI coding assistants into the team's development process, sharing best practices to improve overall engineering velocity</li>
</ul>
<p>Bonus Points If You Have:</p>
<ul>
<li>Familiarity with Agile methodologies.</li>
<li>Understanding of HTML5 and mobile responsive development.</li>
<li>Contributions to OSS projects or Stackoverflow.</li>
<li>Availability for after hours support. We work at a sustainable 40h/week pace but sometimes things go bump in the night.</li>
</ul>
<p>Why We Love AccuLynx:</p>
<p>AccuLynx’s success as the #1 business management software for roofing contractors over the past 11 years is thanks to us investing in our employees, maintaining company values and focusing on a strong company culture. Our positive work environment has allowed us to retain employees that have been with us since our company’s inception and has provided the solid groundwork for us to develop an industry-leading product while exceeding our customer’s expectations. Because of our commitment to our company values and culture, we were recently officially recognized as a Great Place to Work Certified™ organization, with 90% of our employees naming AccuLynx as a great place to work.</p>
<p>We’re proud to regularly be recognized for software, product and company culture achievements. Our team’s shared belief in AccuLynx's mission promotes a culture of collaboration, innovation and fun. We have built a benefits program to match the strength of our team. This program includes:</p>
<ul>
<li>Attractive compensation packages</li>
<li>Flexible paid time off - 3 weeks off in your first year!</li>
<li>Competitive health coverage (medical, dental, vision)</li>
<li>401K matching and safe harbor contributions</li>
</ul>
<p>Our Interview Process:</p>
<p>We do not hire based on buzzwords or popular acronyms. We expect you to be a master of your domain and be eager to learn any technology or language in the future. We aim to reply to your application within a week of receiving it. Our interview process consists of several stages, each one allowing us get to know you better, professionally and technically. It is also an opportunity for you to gain a better understanding of our culture and the work we do at AccuLynx. The stages include:</p>
<ul>
<li>CV, open source code, or public portfolio review</li>
<li>Phone interview with HR team</li>
<li>Face to Face conversation with a few members of your team.</li>
</ul>
<p><em>Applicants must be able to work legally within the United States. Please, no 3rd party inquiries.</em></p>
<p><em>AccuLynx is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to inclusion and employing a diverse workforce. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, or other legally protected characteristics.</em></p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/acculynx-senior-software-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/acculynx-senior-software-engineer</a></p>
</description>

key-value, and time-series databases.<br>- Knowledge of scalable data model design and management.<br>- Knowledge of ML model deployment.<br>- Knowledge of AWS cloud platforms.<br>- Knowledge of TDD and BDD.<br>- Strong interest in improving software development skills, frameworks, and technologies.</p><p><strong>Engagement highlights</strong><br>- Opportunity to work across data modeling, data services, and data science within a broader Data Intelligence Platform.<br>- Exposure to a varied technical environment spanning AWS, ETL pipelines, databases, search technologies, and recommendation systems.<br>- Direct collaboration with data science teams and internal stakeholders on reporting, transformation, and platform capabilities.</p>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Sweden
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://career.proxify.io">http://career.proxify.io</a>
</p>

<h3><strong>The Role:</strong></h3>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>We are looking for a Senior Backend (Node.js / Nest.js) Developer to join our fast-growing network. You’ll be responsible for building modern and scalable web applications, working closely with backend developers and designers to create intuitive user experiences.</p>
<p>This is a long-term, full-time remote role with opportunities to work on innovative projects that make a difference.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h4><strong>What we’re looking for:</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>5+ years with Node.js and 3+ past years with Nest.js</li>
<li>Strong expertise in Node.js and Nest.js frameworks.</li>
<li>Proven experience building REST and/or GraphQL APIs.</li>
<li>Strong knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript.</li>
<li>Solid experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB).</li>
<li>Familiarity with authentication/authorization mechanisms (JWT, OAuth2).</li>
<li>Experience with unit/integration testing (e.g., Jest, Mocha).</li>
<li>Proficiency with Git and version control workflows.</li>
<li>Located in CET timezone (+/- 3 hours), we are unable to consider applications from candidates in other time zones.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h4><strong>Nice to Have:</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).</li>
<li>Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.</li>
<li>Understanding of event-driven architecture and message brokers (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka).</li>

<div class="p-rich_text_section">Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. For more information, visit <a class="c-link" href="http://www.redditinc.com/">www.redditinc.com</a>.</div>

<p>The Identity and Access Management team develops and maintains a set of mission critical, highly performant, and highly scalable systems that manage user identity, authentication, and authorization for all of our millions of daily users and backend services.</p>
<p><strong>Some of our present and future challenges include:</strong></p>
<ul>

<li>Design, build and ship backend services powering experiences for one of the most visited sites in the world.</li>

</ul>
<p><strong>In your day-to-day, you will:</strong></p>

      <title>Pinterest: Data Scientist II, Infrastructure</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> San Francisco, CA, US; Remote, US
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Pinterest:</strong></p>
<p>Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.</p>
<p>Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the&nbsp;<a href="https://www.pinterestcareers.com/our-life/pinflex/">flexibility</a> to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.</p>
<p>At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.</p>
<p>Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process <a href="https://www.pinterestcareers.com/our-philosophy-on-ai-in-hiring/">here</a>.</p></div><p>Pinterest brings millions of people the inspiration to create a life they love. Behind that experience is a complex infrastructure ecosystem that powers reliability, performance, measurement, and efficiency across the platform. As Pinterest grows, it’s increasingly important that we understand these systems clearly so we can make smarter decisions for both Pinners and the business.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join our Infrastructure Data Science team. In this role, you’ll partner with engineering and cross-functional teams to make Pinterest’s infrastructure more measurable, intelligible, and actionable. Depending on the area, your work may span app performance, shopping infrastructure, metrics quality, infrastructure governance, or site reliability. You’ll help build the data foundations, measurement systems, and analytical frameworks that enable Pinterest to optimize core technical systems and make better product and infrastructure decisions.<br><br></p>
<p><strong>What you’ll do:</strong></p>
<p>In this role, you will partner closely with engineering and cross-functional teams to improve how Pinterest measures, understands, and optimizes its infrastructure:</p>
<ul>
<li>Partner with engineering teams to define, measure, and improve the health, quality, and efficiency of Pinterest’s infrastructure systems.</li>
<li>Build and refine metrics, dashboards, and analytical frameworks that make complex technical systems more understandable and actionable.</li>
<li>Strengthen data foundations by improving metric definitions, auditing data quality, and contributing to pipeline and measurement improvements where needed.</li>
<li>Design and analyze experiments, investigations, and deep dives to quantify the impact of infrastructure changes on user experience, reliability, and business outcomes.</li>
<li>Translate ambiguous technical problems into clear analyses and actionable recommendations for engineering and platform partners.</li>
<li>Support high-priority investigations and decision-making related to infrastructure performance, reliability, cost, and measurement quality.</li>
<li>Identify opportunities to improve how Pinterest measures and optimizes infrastructure across a range of domains, such as performance, shopping infrastructure, governance, metrics quality, and site reliability.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What we’re looking for:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Masters degree in a relevant field such as Statistics, Applied Math, Biostatistics, or equivalent experience.</li>
<li>Strong SQL and analytical programming skills, with experience working through messy, imperfect data and building reliable metrics and datasets.</li>
<li>Experience partnering on or contributing to production-ready data pipelines, measurement systems, or foundational data work that improves data quality and usability.</li>
<li>Solid foundation in experimentation and measurement, with the ability to design analyses, interpret results rigorously, and partner effectively with engineers and other cross-functional stakeholders.</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous problems into clear analytical workstreams and actionable recommendations.</li>
<li>Strong cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings clearly to engineering, product, and platform stakeholders.</li>
<li>Ability to operate independently, prioritize across both longer-term projects and fast-turn inbound requests, and drive work forward in a dynamic environment.</li>
<li>Curiosity and a builder mindset, with excitement for improving messy systems and creating more scalable, trustworthy measurement foundations.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Relocation Statement:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1">We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span class="s1"><strong>In-Office Requirement Statement:</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li>This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our<a href="https://www.pinterestcareers.com/pinflex/"> PinFlex</a> page to learn more about our working model.</li>
<li>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1">This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times/quarter and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.</span></p>
</li>
</ul>

<p>

</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://fin.ai/">Fin</a>, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.</p>
<p>Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p>
<p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.</p>
<p>Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><h2>What's the opportunity?&nbsp;</h2>
<p>Fin is looking for an exceptional Solutions Architect to join our vibrant Customer Solutions Team. In this role, you’ll engage directly with our customers as their trusted advisor, playing a pivotal part in defining and demonstrating value across the entire sales cycle. With a natural curiosity, independent thinking, and strong problem-solving skills, you’ll partner closely with Product, R&amp;D, and Engineering to ensure our customers’ needs and insights are at the core of our AI powered solutions.</p>
<h2>What will I be doing?&nbsp;</h2>
<ul>
<li>Lead technical discovery to identify and address our customers’ needs</li>
<li>Deliver an exceptional pre-sales experience by articulating Fin's value and technical expertise</li>
<li>Conduct impactful, value-based solution reviews and in-depth technical sessions</li>
<li>Design and lead tailored Proof of Concepts (POCs) that showcase Fin's capabilities</li>
<li>Serve as the primary resource for RFPs and customer security questions, utilizing standardized materials and escalating complex issues</li>
<li>Collaborate cross-functionally with Product and Engineering to represent the customer voice, gathering feedback and insights for product planning</li>
<li>Build trust with customers by approaching challenges with empathy and curiosity</li>
<li>Continuously improve processes and contribute to building a best-in-class Solutions Engineering playbook at Fin</li>
<li>Commit to customer success, ensuring lasting value and proactively addressing challenges</li>
</ul>
<h2>What skills do I need?&nbsp;</h2>
<ul>
<li>Minimum of 3 years of experience in a technical sales role, managing C-Level technical and business relationships</li>
<li>Strong technical acumen with experience in conducting technical discovery and delivering high-impact value presentations.</li>
<li>Ability to solve problems independently while thriving in collaborative team environments</li>
<li>Proven time management skills in a dynamic team environment&nbsp;</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to quickly identify and communicate the value proposition throughout the sales cycle.</li>
<li>Leverage your skills in translating complex business challenges into tailored Fin solutions, effectively communicating with both technical and non-technical audiences to drive understanding and impact.</li>
<li>Experience working closely with product and engineering teams to communicate customer feedback and influence product direction.</li>
<li>Familiarity with managing POCs, RFPs, and addressing complex security questions.</li>
<li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a passion for leading with empathy and curiosity</li>
<li>Ability to challenge the status quo and continuously improve Solutions Engineering processes and playbooks</li>
<li>Bring an open mind, be a collaborative colleague with a commitment to go above and beyond to drive the success of your team and the company</li>
<li>Willing and able to travel occasionally</li>
</ul>
<p>*Proof of eligibility to work in the United States is required.</p>
<p>The OTE salary range for candidates within the San Francisco Bay Area or New York City is $190,800-$227,900 Actual base pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, location, etc. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All regular employees may also be eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p><span>#LI-Hybrid</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Unleash Your Potential</strong></p>
<p>When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.</p>
<p>In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at<a href="http://fin.ai/careers"> fin.ai/careers</a>. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Policies&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.</p>
<p>We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.intercom.com/careers">core values</a>.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p>Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination.&nbsp;<a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/know-your-rights-workplace-discrimination-illegal">Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal.</a> Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p></div>
